relations.rationale: The number of teams has no bearing on whether the group settled into tents by evening.

Yara tracking time to reach camp before sunset is a separate motivation from the clouds prompting quickened pace, though both relate to urgency, they are distinct causes and don't directly affect each other's likelihood.
Clouds gathering over the peaks directly caused the group to quicken their pace as stated.
Quickening pace toward the campsite makes it more likely the group arrived and settled into tents by evening.
Settling into tents by evening is consistent with and supports the idea that the group was tired but satisfied with progress.
Having settled into tents suggests the group was ready to rest before continuing the hike.
Being tired but satisfied naturally supports being ready to rest before the next leg.
